name: Nösslinge - Åkulla
description: Nösslinge to Åkulla. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Dricksvatten Åkulla Outdoor Resort: Tap water at Åkulla Outdoor Resort for filling bottles.
notes: Run a precise protected-area polygon overlay before final normalization to determine the exact Märkedalen and Åkullaboket route spans.
Timing note: Official Hallandsleden page/API had no time value. Route-app times are planning hints only.

facilities.name: Hållplats Gällarp
facilities.description: Bus stop directly by Gällarpesjön and the official N6 start. Official text says line 661 from Varberg station.

facilities.name: Parkering Gällarpesjön
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan and OSM from N5/N6 access checks
facilities.description: Parking adjacent to the Gällarpesjön shelter/toilet/start area.

facilities.name: Toalett Gällarpesjön
facilities.description: Year-round toilet by the Gällarpesjön parking, with a small lakeside rest area, waste bins and recycling containers.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Gällarpesjön
facilities.description: Start-area shelter/campsite for 4-5 adults with fireplace and wood store. Bathing and fishing nearby; fishing permit may be required. No drinking water at the shelter.

facilities.name: Nösslinge kyrka
facilities.description: Red wooden church with medieval origins. Important as the landmark/service-building location for the off-route drinking water at the Nösslinge/Gällarpesjön end.

facilities.name: Stora Neten / Lake Stora Neten
facilities.description: Official scenic lake POI. Stora Neten is a municipal drinking-water source for Varberg; do not model as potable untreated water.

facilities.name: Märkedalens reservat
facilities.description: Nature reserve passed by Hallandsleden. Dramatic terrain with beech/oak forest, block slopes, cliff faces and steep slopes down toward Stora Neten.

facilities.name: Hållplats Brännhult
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API; ResRobot nearby at 57.150333, 12.544294
facilities.description: Bus line 651 stop used for access into Åkulla Bokskogar. Useful as fallback access, not a normal N6 endpoint stop.

facilities.name: Hållplats Haksered
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API; ResRobot nearby at 57.150369, 12.580745
facilities.description: Bus line 651 stop by road 153 into the Åkulla Bokskogar area. Official section text says Haksered is about 6 km north of Åkulla Outdoor Resort.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Åkulla
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API; Naturkartan corroborates nearby
facilities.description: Endpoint shelter/campsite near Åkulla Outdoor Resort with fireplace. Drinking water, toilet, shower, food and firewood are at the resort.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Yasjön
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API; Naturkartan corroborates nearby
facilities.description: Shelter/campsite on an island about 150 m out in Yasjön, reached by hand-pulled cable raft. Fireplace exists, but no firewood is available on the island; buy or bring wood from Åkulla. Island access is prohibited 1 March-30 June during bird nesting and the cable raft normally operates 1 July to mid-October.

facilities.name: Åkulla Outdoor Resort
facilities.description: Endpoint resort directly by the trail with lodging, food/drink, toilets, showers, tap water, firewood, camping/ställplats options, service building and activities.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten Åkulla Outdoor Resort
facilities.description: Tap water at Åkulla Outdoor Resort for filling bottles.

facilities.name: Hållplats Åkulla
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API; ResRobot nearby at 57.124012, 12.566353
facilities.description: Seasonal Åkturen stop at Åkulla. Strong endpoint access only during the summer Åkturen service.
